about: Hand-written rotation guides for the priest's player pages (guides.py).

raid.plan: Shadow in a raid keeps **Shadow Word: Pain** on the boss, casts **Devouring Plague**, **Shadow Word: Death** and **Mind Blast** each time they come off cooldown, and channels **Mind Flay** in every gap. **Shadowform** goes up before the pull and stays up all fight.
why: **Shadowform** is what makes the spec work: 10% more Shadow damage, half the mana cost on every Shadow spell and a doubled critical strike bonus. You cannot cast heals while in it.

**Shadow Word: Pain** is first because it does about a fifth of your damage for one global cooldown every 24 seconds (18, plus 6 from **Improved Shadow Word: Pain**). Recast it only after it falls off, and not in the last 10 seconds of the fight, when a new one gets only a few ticks.

**Inner Focus** makes your next spell free, and the list spends it on **Devouring Plague** at the pull (it comes back every 3 minutes, so once in a 3-minute fight). Its 25% crit bonus does not apply to a damage-over-time spell (beta notes of 2026-10-01), so the pair only saves mana; it comes from the community simulator's own rotation.

After that, **Devouring Plague** goes out each time its 1-minute cooldown ends, as soon as **Shadow Word: Death** and **Mind Blast** are both cooling down: three casts a fight, counting the free one; the simulator measured 2.5% more damage casting it on cooldown. **Devouring Contagion** halves its cost, and it heals you for the damage it deals.

**Shadow Word: Death** comes before **Mind Blast** because its cooldown is longer (15 seconds against 5.5 with **Improved Mind Blast**), so waiting costs it more; the simulator measured 0.4% more damage in this order. Below 20% of the boss's health, **Early Demise** adds 30% to its crit chance.

**Mind Flay** fills every gap and does almost half your damage: a 3-second channel that **Improved Mind Flay** makes 20% stronger. Every Shadow spell also stacks **Shadow Weaving** on you (2% Shadow damage a stack, up to 5, for 15 seconds), so while you keep casting it stays at 5 by itself.
caveats: **Shadow Word: Death** hits you for 10% of your maximum health every time the target survives it, about 11 times in a 3-minute fight. The damage numbers ignore that; your healers do not. **Devouring Plague** heals some of it back.

**Mind Blast** causes a lot of threat (its tooltip says so). In the first seconds of a fight or after a tank swap, hold it until the tank is ahead; **Shadow Affinity** in this build cuts the threat of your Shadow spells by 30%.

When you must move, **Mind Flay** and **Mind Blast** stop: use your instants, **Shadow Word: Death**, **Devouring Plague** and **Shadow Word: Pain** if it fell off. **Shadow Weaving** drops after 15 seconds without a Shadow spell.
Mana is not your problem in a full raid: the simulator's priest never runs dry, with one mana potion and two Demonic Runes a fight.
diverge: With adds up, keep **Shadow Word: Pain** on the ones that live longest and put **Devouring Plague** on one that dies first: **Devouring Contagion** makes the plague jump to a nearby enemy when its target dies. The simulator fights one target, so this is not measured.
**Silence** is in this build but not in the list: use it to stop a casting add. It costs one global cooldown.

**Vampiric Embrace** has no line because the simulator counts only damage. If your group takes damage, cast it on the boss: for 30 seconds your party heals for 20% of your Shadow damage, for 40 mana and one global cooldown a minute.
If your healers struggle, save **Shadow Word: Death** for the last 20% of the boss's health, where **Early Demise** makes it crit more. You give up some damage to stop the backlash.

leveling.plan: Shadow levels on a short loop: your opening spells land while the mob runs in, **Mind Flay** slows and kills it, and **Shadow Word: Death** or your wand finishes it. **Shadowform** at 40 is the big step: the fight lab's time per kill drops from 36 to 22 seconds between levels 30 and 40.
why: Open from as far away as you can (the build's one point in **Shadow Reach** adds 10% range, **Mind Flay**'s included): the fight lab casts the instants first (**Vampiric Embrace** when it is ready, then **Shadow Word: Pain**) and **Mind Blast**, your biggest hit, right after, so all three land while the mob walks in.

**Vampiric Embrace** and **Devouring Plague** are your heals once **Shadowform** stops real heals. The fight lab casts **Vampiric Embrace** whenever it is ready (once a minute) and **Devouring Plague** only when you are below 80% health and the mob above half, so the plague is a heal here, not damage.

**Mind Flay** is your filler and your biggest damage share: it slows the mob by 50% while you channel (20% once you take **Improved Mind Flay**), so a mob walking in reaches you later. **Mind Blast** goes out whenever it is ready.

From 32, **Shadow Word: Death** finishes. The fight lab casts it when one cast will kill the mob, so its backlash (10% of your health when the target survives) never lands, and below 20% health once you have **Early Demise** (level 35). From 40 it does about a sixth of a Shadow leveler's damage and the wand is rarely needed.
Before 32 your wand finishes: when a mob has a hit or two of wand damage left, a new spell would be wasted mana. **Mind Blast** also finishes a mob when one cast kills it.

Mana: **Spirit Tap** doubles your Spirit for 15 seconds after kills and **Shadowform** halves your Shadow costs, so the tuned rules drink only below 15% mana, not at a third. They also skip the pre-pull **Power Word: Shield** unless you start a pull below half health: the fight lab measured that about 12% faster, since the shield is not a Shadow spell and costs full mana.
caveats: **Shadowform** blocks your heals but cuts the physical damage you take by 15%: from 40 your only healing in a fight is **Vampiric Embrace** and **Devouring Plague**, and between fights you eat (below about two thirds of your health) instead of casting **Renew**.
Before 20 there is no **Mind Flay**: you use **Mind Blast**, **Shadow Word: Pain** and the wand. The fight lab never casts **Smite** as Shadow; it measured leveling slightly faster without it.
Two or three mobs at once: put **Shadow Word: Pain** on each and use **Psychic Scream** (below 40% of your health with a mob on you) to buy time. The no-shield rule was tuned on single pulls.
diverge: When a pull goes wrong (an add, a caster pack), shield yourself: **Power Word: Shield** absorbs damage and stops pushback on your casts while it holds.
Below 40% health with the mob on you: **Psychic Scream**, then **Flash Heal** if you are not in **Shadowform** yet.

raid.plan: Smite in a raid keeps two burns up, **Shadow Word: Pain** and **Holy Fire**, fires **Penance** whenever it is ready and casts **Smite** in every gap. **Holy Fire** counts for more than its own damage: with **Power in Light** your **Smite** and **Penance** deal 10% more while it burns.
why: **Holy Fire** starts 3 seconds before the pull (a 3-second cast with **Divine Fury**), so it lands as the fight begins. Recast it when its burn has about 1.5 seconds left, roughly every 12 seconds: the new one lands just after the old burn ends, and the simulator measured that 0.5% ahead of starting 3 seconds early.

**Penance** is on top: three Holy bolts in 2 seconds on a 12-second cooldown, about a quarter of your damage, and the simulator measured 3.1% more damage with it first. The full list casts rank 3 (from the community simulator's rotation): a little less damage than rank 4 for 30% less mana, and high enough that our downranking model leaves it its full spell power.
**Shadow Word: Pain** is about 30% of this build's damage for one global cooldown every 18 seconds. Recast it when it falls off, but not in the last 10 seconds of the fight.

**Inner Focus** goes into **Devouring Plague** to make it free (its 3-minute cooldown allows one in a 3-minute fight; the list's second **Inner Focus** line, into **Smite**, only comes up in longer fights); the simulator measured about 1% more damage with that pair. Paid for, the plague costs this build about 890 mana (no **Shadowform** or **Devouring Contagion** to cut it), and the simulator measured 2.0% more damage after dropping the plain **Devouring Plague** line.

**Shadow Word: Death** and **Power Infusion** go out on cooldown, then **Smite** fills everything else. **Mind Blast** is left out: none of your Holy talents help it and it costs more mana than **Smite**, and the simulator measured about 5% more damage casting **Smite** in its place.
caveats: This build runs short of mana even in a full raid: the simulator's priest also uses two mana potions and two Demonic Runes a fight. **Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast, and the cheaper ranks the full list picks (rank 3 **Penance**, rank 3 **Shadow Word: Death**, the latter measured 0.5% better than rank 4) are part of the mana plan; neither is far enough below your level to lose spell power in our downranking model.

The full list still holds a rank 2 **Smite** for 20-50% mana, measured before 2026-10-09; it now sits under the top-rank **Smite** and never fires. Ranks far below your level get much less from your spell power (a beta change; our model leaves rank 2 a small fraction of it), so do not downrank **Smite**.
**Shadow Word: Death** hits you for 10% of your maximum health each time the boss survives it, about 10 times a fight: your healers pay for that.
The full list also holds **Mind Blast**, **Shadowform** and **Mind Flay** lines below the unconditional **Smite**: they never fire for this build.
diverge: When the boss has under 3 seconds to live, cast **Smite** (2 seconds) rather than a new **Holy Fire** (3 seconds): only a spell that finishes casting does damage.
If healing is tight, cast **Shadow Word: Death** only in the last 20% of the boss's health, as the simulator's rotation for fighting alone does. You give up a little damage.
When you must move, use the instants: **Shadow Word: Death**, and **Shadow Word: Pain** if it fell off. **Holy Fire**, **Smite** and **Penance** all need you to stand still.

leveling.plan: Leveling as Smite: pull with the instant **Shadow Word: Pain**, cast **Mind Blast** whenever it is ready and **Penance** while you have more than 30% mana, **Smite** while the mob has more than a third of its health, and let your wand finish. A **Power Word: Shield** before every pull lets you keep casting in melee.
why: **Shadow Word: Pain** pulls because it is instant and ticks for the whole fight; **Shadow Reach** gives it 20% more range.

**Penance** and **Mind Blast** hit harder for their cast time than **Smite**, so they go first whenever ready; since the 2026-10-15 re-tune **Penance** waits while you are below 30% mana (about 2% faster). **Penance** is this build's most valuable talent: the fight lab is 6.6 seconds per kill slower at 60 without it.

**Smite** only while the mob has more than about a third of its health and you have more than 30% mana. Below that your wand finishes without spending mana or starting a cast the mob may not live through; the fight lab (re-tuned 2026-10-15) measured the two limits about 4% and 1-2% faster.
Skip **Holy Fire**: a slow cast whose damage Forever cut about in half, and the fight lab measured leveling about 1-2% faster without it. That is also why this build takes no **Power in Light**.
**Inner Focus** at the start of a pull, whenever it is ready: press it right before **Mind Blast** or **Smite** to make that cast free with 25% more crit chance.

Mana: **Spirit Tap** doubles your Spirit for 15 seconds after each kill and **Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast, so drink only below 15% mana (measured about 1-2% faster than at 35%). After a fight, **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk; eat only if you are still low.
caveats: The pre-pull shield is part of this rotation: **Smite** takes 2 seconds or more to cast, and while **Power Word: Shield** holds, damage does not push your casts back. In melee, shield again once Weakened Soul is gone and you are below 80% health.
**Penance** comes at level 37 in this order; before that **Mind Blast** and **Smite** carry the damage.
This build has no area damage: pull one mob at a time. With two on you, **Psychic Scream** sends them running.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60% if it is not already on you.
For pure speed, level as Shadow: 26 seconds per kill in the fight lab against this build's 40.

raid.plan: The healer lab's Holy priest heals the tank with **Penance** every time it is ready and with **Greater Heal** downranked to the damage he has taken, uses **Prayer of Healing** when two or more of the group are hurt, and keeps **Power Word: Shield** and **Flash Heal** for emergencies. Mana is the limit: even so, the lab's Holy priest spends part of its five-minute fight out of mana.
why: **Penance** goes on the tank whenever it comes off cooldown and he is missing most of what it heals. Since 2026-10-08 it heals more per mana than **Heal** and **Greater Heal**, and the healer lab measured about 6% more capacity than keeping it for emergencies.

**Greater Heal** is still your biggest heal. Start it on the tank when he is missing about half of what it heals and a boss swing is coming, at the lowest rank that covers what he is missing: the rest of a bigger rank would be overheal.

**Prayer of Healing** when two or more of your group are below 70% health (the class's tuned heal policy: two, not three). In Forever it heals the target and the target's party, so aim it at the group that is hurt.

**Renew** goes on the tank once he is missing a fifth of his health (the tuned policy, rather than a tenth), and on a hurt raid member before a direct heal. It can crit since the beta's 2026-10-08 build.

**Inner Focus** goes on a full-rank **Greater Heal** when the tank is missing more than half of one: the heal is free and 25% more likely to crit, and a critical heal gives the tank 25% more armor for 15 seconds through **Inspiration**.

In an emergency (anyone below 20% health): **Power Word: Shield** on the tank if Weakened Soul is gone, then **Penance** if it is ready, then a full-rank **Flash Heal**. That threshold is the class's tuned heal policy (the default was 35%).
caveats: Mana runs out before healing power does: **Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast, and **Improved Healing** makes **Greater Heal** and **Penance** 15% cheaper. The tuned policy takes a mana potion below 40% of your mana.
This build has no **Prayer of Mending** (it needs 31 points in Holy) and no **Soul Warding**, so your shield keeps its 4-second cooldown.

Ranks far below your level now get less from your healing power (a beta change; the formula is our assumption). In our model **Greater Heal** ranks 3 to 5 lose nothing and rank 1 about 15%, so downranking within **Greater Heal** still pays.
The lab is one healer keeping a tank and four players alive for five minutes. It does not model movement, dispels or other healers.
diverge: **Litany of Light** gives back 10% of a heal's base cost when it differs from your previous heal, so when two heals fit equally well, alternate them.
**Holy Nova** heals everyone around you; the lab never casts it, so use it only when your group stands together and is hurt.

leveling.plan: You level with your raid talents, Discipline first: **Penance** at 30 is the big step, and the Holy talents from 31 on mostly heal. The fight is a Smite priest's: an instant pull with **Shadow Word: Pain**, **Penance** and **Mind Blast** on cooldown, **Smite** in between, your wand to finish.
why: **Shadow Word: Pain** pulls because it is instant and ticks for the whole fight. **Penance** (from 30) and **Mind Blast** hit harder for their cast time than **Smite**, so they go out whenever ready; **Penance** only while you have more than 30% mana (tuned 2026-10-15, about 2% faster).

**Smite** only while the mob has more than about a third of its health and you have more than 30% mana: below that your wand finishes without spending mana. The fight lab (re-tuned 2026-10-15) measured these limits about 3.5% and 2% faster.

Skip **Holy Fire**: a slow cast whose damage Forever cut about in half, and the fight lab measured leveling about 2% faster without it. Your **Power in Light** point does nothing while leveling: they need **Holy Fire** burning and are there for the raid build.
**Inner Focus** (from 20) at the start of a pull: press it right before **Mind Blast** or **Smite** to make that cast free with 25% more crit chance.

Mana: **Meditation** (levels 24 and 28-29) keeps half your regeneration going while you cast, so drink only below 15% mana. After a fight, **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk on; eat only if you are still below two thirds of your health (the 2026-10-15 re-tune dropped the earlier 80% rule).
caveats: Most of your Holy points are for healing (**Spiritual Guidance**, **Spiritual Healing**, **Improved Renew**, **Litany of Light**), so this is a slow way to level: 50 seconds per kill in the fight lab (level-weighted), against 25 for Shadow.
The pre-pull **Power Word: Shield** is part of this rotation: while it holds, damage does not push your **Smite** back. In melee, shield again once Weakened Soul is gone and you are below 80% health.
**Holy Nova** (level 41) is for pulls of several mobs: the fight lab casts it only when two or more are in reach.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60%; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.

raid.plan: The healer lab plays Discipline with the class's heal choices: **Penance** on the tank whenever it is ready, downranked **Greater Heal** on the tank, **Prayer of Healing** for the group, and **Power Word: Shield** and **Flash Heal** for emergencies. **Renewed Hope** and **Divine Aegis** are what the Discipline points buy; this build takes no **Power Infusion**.
why: **Penance** goes on the tank whenever it comes off cooldown and he is missing most of what it heals. Since 2026-10-08 it heals more per mana than **Heal** and **Greater Heal**, and the healer lab measured about 4% more capacity than keeping it for emergencies.

**Greater Heal** on the tank is your biggest heal (0.3 seconds faster with 3 points in **Divine Fury**). Start it when he is missing about half of what it heals and a boss swing is coming, at the lowest rank that covers the damage.

In an emergency (anyone below 20% health): **Power Word: Shield** on the tank if Weakened Soul is gone, then **Penance** if it is ready, then a full-rank **Flash Heal**. **Soul Warding** removes the shield's 4-second cooldown and cuts its cost by 15%.

After a shield, heal the tank directly: with **Renewed Hope** your **Flash Heal**, **Greater Heal** and **Penance** crit 10% more often on a target with Weakened Soul, and each cuts 5 seconds off it, so the next shield comes sooner. Each crit also leaves an absorb of 15% of the heal (**Divine Aegis**) and 25% more armor for 15 seconds (**Inspiration**).

**Inner Focus** on a full-rank **Greater Heal** when the tank is missing more than half of one; **Prayer of Healing** when two or more of the group drop below 70%; **Renew** on the tank once he is missing a fifth of his health.
caveats: Mana runs out first. **Meditation** keeps half your regeneration going while you cast; the tuned policy takes a mana potion below 40% of your mana.

The lab shields only in emergencies: shielding the tank every time Weakened Soul ends measured slightly worse there, because the shields cost mana the fight runs short of. With mana to spare, extra shields feed **Renewed Hope**; the lab did not find that.

Ranks far below your level now get less from your healing power (a beta change; the formula is our assumption). In our model **Greater Heal** ranks 3 to 5 lose nothing, so downranking within **Greater Heal** still pays.
This build gives up **Power Infusion**, **Spiritual Guidance**, **Spiritual Healing** and **Prayer of Mending**; in the healer lab it holds less than the Holy page's build.
diverge: When the tank takes a big hit while Weakened Soul is still on him, cast **Penance** or **Flash Heal** at once: each also takes 5 seconds off Weakened Soul (**Renewed Hope**), so you can shield again sooner.
**Litany of Light** gives back 10% of a heal's base cost when it differs from your previous heal: alternate heals when two fit equally well.

leveling.plan: You level with your raid talents, all Discipline first: **Penance** at 35 carries the damage. The fight is a Smite priest's: an instant pull with **Shadow Word: Pain**, **Penance** and **Mind Blast** on cooldown, **Smite** in between, your wand to finish.
why: **Shadow Word: Pain** pulls because it is instant and ticks for the whole fight. **Penance** (from 35) and **Mind Blast** hit harder for their cast time than **Smite**, so they go out whenever ready; **Penance** only while you have more than 30% mana (tuned 2026-10-15, about 2% faster).
**Inner Focus** (from 20) at the start of a pull: press it right before **Mind Blast** or **Smite** to make that cast free with 25% more crit chance.

**Smite** only while the mob has more than about a third of its health and you have more than 30% mana; below that your wand finishes. The fight lab (re-tuned 2026-10-15) measured these limits about 4% and 1% faster, and skipping **Holy Fire** (a slow cast whose damage Forever cut about in half) another 1%.

**Renewed Hope** (level 36) ties your heals to your shield: a **Flash Heal** on yourself while Weakened Soul is on you crits 10% more often and cuts 5 seconds off Weakened Soul, so your next **Power Word: Shield** comes sooner.

Mana: **Meditation** (levels 31-33) keeps half your regeneration going while you cast, so drink only below 15% mana (measured about 1.5% faster than at 35%). After a fight, **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk; eat only if you are still below two thirds of your health.
caveats: This is the slowest priest leveling page: 52 seconds per kill in the fight lab (level-weighted), Shadow 25. The fight lab does not count **Divine Aegis** or **Inspiration**: they are raid talents.
This build takes no **Power Infusion**: skip the list's **Power Infusion** line.

The pre-pull **Power Word: Shield** is part of this rotation: while it holds, damage does not push your **Smite** back, and **Soul Warding** (level 34) removes its 4-second cooldown and cuts its cost by 15%.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
If you only want to reach 60, level as Shadow and respec: half the time per kill in the fight lab.

leveling.plan: The Discipline-Shadow build plays the Discipline leveling list (a Smite priest's) with Shadow's damage talents behind it: an instant pull with **Shadow Word: Pain**, **Mind Blast** on cooldown, **Smite** in between, your wand to finish, a **Power Word: Shield** before every pull. Discipline comes first (levels 10-31), Shadow from 32.
why: **Shadow Word: Pain** and **Mind Blast** are your Shadow spells, and the Shadow points make them hit harder: **Improved Shadow Word: Pain** (levels 37 and 50) makes the pain last 6 seconds longer, **Shadow Weaving** (47-49) and **Darkness** (57-60) add Shadow damage, and **Improved Mind Blast** (43-46 and 51) brings **Mind Blast** back 2.5 seconds sooner.

Mana is the limit, and the build pays for it: in the fight lab its most valuable talents at 60 are **Meditation** (half your regeneration while casting) and **Spirit Tap** (double Spirit for 15 seconds after a kill), ahead of **Darkness** and **Shadow Weaving**.

**Smite** only while the mob has more than about a third of its health and you have more than 30% mana; below that your wand finishes (**Wand Specialization** adds 25%). Skip **Holy Fire**: the tuned rules never cast it.
**Inner Focus** (level 20) right before **Mind Blast** or **Smite** makes that cast free with 25% more crit chance. **Silence** (level 54) stops a caster mob's spell.
caveats: This build takes neither **Penance**, **Power Infusion** nor **Renewed Hope**: skip those lines.

The Discipline list never casts **Mind Flay**, **Vampiric Embrace** or **Devouring Plague**: those points (**Vampiric Embrace**, **Devouring Contagion**) only open the deeper Shadow tiers here. The fight lab measured this build at about 43 seconds per kill (level-weighted), against 25 for the Shadow page.
Drink below 15% of your mana; after a fight, **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk, and you eat only below two thirds of your health.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60%; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
For speed, the Shadow page levels about 40% faster per kill.

leveling.plan: The Holy-Shadow build plays the Holy leveling list (a Smite priest's) with points in all three trees: an instant pull with **Shadow Word: Pain**, **Mind Blast** on cooldown, **Smite** in between, your wand to finish, a **Power Word: Shield** before every pull. The order takes Shadow first (levels 10-28, one **Wand Specialization** point at 25), then Discipline (29-43), then Holy (44-60).
why: The early Shadow points make your two Shadow spells hit harder and your mana last: **Spirit Tap** (levels 13-17: double Spirit for 15 seconds after a kill), **Improved Shadow Word: Pain** (18-19), **Improved Mind Blast** (21-24) and **Shadow Weaving** (26-28). In the fight lab **Meditation** (38-40), **Improved Shadow Word: Pain** and **Spirit Tap** are the build's most valuable talents at 60.

**Smite** only while the mob has more than about a third of its health and you have more than 30% mana; below that your wand finishes (**Wand Specialization**). Skip **Holy Fire**: the tuned rules never cast it. **Divine Fury** (54-58) cuts **Smite** by half a second and **Searing Light** (59-60) adds 5% Holy damage.
**Inner Focus** (level 41) right before **Mind Blast** or **Smite** makes that cast free with 25% more crit chance.
Mana: drink below 15% of your mana; after a fight **Renew** heals you while you loot and walk, and you eat only below two thirds of your health (the 2026-10-15 re-tune dropped the earlier 80% rule).
caveats: This build takes no **Penance**: skip its line.

**Mind Flay** (level 20) is in the build but the Holy list never casts it, so its point only counts toward the Shadow tiers. The fight lab measured this build at about 43 seconds per kill (level-weighted), against 25 for the Shadow page.
diverge: Hurt in a fight: shield again below half your health, **Flash Heal** below about a third, **Renew** below 60%; **Psychic Scream** if a mob is on you and you are below 40%.
For speed, the Shadow page levels about 40% faster per kill.
